initial_state: Open original prepared15mmfixture in the identified native app; wait for rest mesh, simulation off. Save/export before snapshot.
actions: Click Assemble (gravity off), observe active stage and Cancel job.
Click Cancel job immediately after observing it, then observe native acknowledgement and retained Rest arrangement.
Save/export after snapshot and independently compare native and OBJ bytes to before.
measurement: Date.now brackets the native click and following AX acknowledgement. Durations include CUA/AX overhead and are UI acknowledgement measurements.
limits: Native UI exposes a simulation batch, not individual preparation/initialization/step phases; exact cancellation phase and worker-thread termination latency remain unmeasured.
No constructor-only latency, live collision speed, garment quality, reference contract or parity pass is claimed.
Prepared original fixture is used only for this cancellation subcase, not as a replacement for empty-project authoring.
